title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study
summary: Emotion plays an important role in human cognition and performance. Motivated by this, we investigate whether analogous emotional signals can shape the behavior of large language models (LLMs) and agents. Existing emotion-aware studies mainly treat emotion as a surface-level style factor or a perception target, overlooking its mechanistic role in task processing. To address this limitation, we propose E-STEER, an interpretable emotion steering framework that enables direct representation-level intervention in LLMs and agents. It embeds emotion as a structured, controllable variable in hidden states, and with it, we examine the impact of emotion on objective reasoning, subjective generation, safety, and multi-step agent behaviors. The results reveal non-monotonic emotion-behavior relations consistent with established psychological theories, and show that specific emotions not only enhance LLM capability but also improve safety, and systematically shape multi-step agent behaviors.

AI.tldr: E-STEER是一个可解释的情感引导框架，通过将情感作为结构化可控变量嵌入LLM隐藏状态，研究情感对LLM推理、生成、安全性和多步代理行为的影响，发现情感与行为之间存在符合心理学理论的非单调关系。
AI.motivation: 现有情感感知研究主要将情感视为表面风格因素或感知目标，忽视了其在任务处理中的机制作用。情感在人类认知和表现中扮演重要角色，因此研究类似情感信号是否能塑造大语言模型和代理的行为具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出E-STEER框架，将情感作为结构化可控变量嵌入LLM隐藏状态，实现表示层面的直接干预。通过该框架研究情感对客观推理、主观生成、安全性和多步代理行为的影响。
AI.result: 研究揭示了情感与行为之间符合心理学理论的非单调关系，发现特定情感不仅能增强LLM能力，还能提高安全性，并系统性地塑造多步代理行为。
AI.conclusion: E-STEER框架为理解和控制LLM及代理中的情感机制提供了新途径，证明了情感在AI系统中的重要作用，为开发更智能、更安全、更人性化的AI系统奠定了基础。

title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large language models applied to clinical prediction exhibit case-level heterogeneity: simple cases yield consistent outputs, while complex cases produce divergent predictions under minor prompt changes. Existing single-agent strategies sample from one role-conditioned distribution, and multi-agent frameworks use fixed roles with flat majority voting, discarding the diagnostic signal in disagreement. We propose CAMP (Case-Adaptive Multi-agent Panel), where an attending-physician agent dynamically assembles a specialist panel tailored to each case's diagnostic uncertainty. Each specialist evaluates candidates via three-valued voting (KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL), enabling principled abstention outside one's expertise. A hybrid router directs each diagnosis through strong consensus, fallback to the attending physician's judgment, or evidence-based arbitration that weighs argument quality over vote counts. On diagnostic prediction and brief hospital course generation from MIMIC-IV across four LLM backbones, CAMP consistently outperforms strong baselines while consuming fewer tokens than most competing multi-agent methods, with voting records and arbitration traces offering transparent decision audits.

AI.tldr: CAMP是一种自适应多智能体医疗诊断框架，通过主治医师智能体根据病例复杂性动态组建专家小组，采用三值投票机制和混合路由决策，在医疗预测任务中优于现有方法且更高效透明。
AI.motivation: 现有临床预测方法存在局限性：单智能体策略仅从单一角色条件分布采样，多智能体框架使用固定角色和平坦多数投票，忽略了诊断分歧中的信号。大语言模型在临床预测中表现出病例级异质性——简单病例输出一致，复杂病例在轻微提示变化下产生分歧预测。
AI.method: 提出CAMP框架：1) 主治医师智能体根据每个病例的诊断不确定性动态组建专家小组；2) 每位专家通过三值投票（KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL）评估候选诊断，允许在专业领域外进行原则性弃权；3) 混合路由器通过强共识、主治医师判断回退或基于证据的仲裁来指导每个诊断，仲裁过程更注重论证质量而非票数。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集上的诊断预测和简要病程生成任务中，使用四种LLM骨干网络，CAMP始终优于强基线方法，同时比大多数竞争性多智能体方法消耗更少的token，投票记录和仲裁痕迹提供了透明的决策审计。
AI.conclusion: CAMP通过动态专家小组组建、三值投票和混合路由机制，有效处理临床预测中的病例级异质性，在保持高效性的同时提供透明决策审计，为医疗AI系统提供了更可靠的诊断框架。

title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
summary: Tool-integrated LLMs can retrieve, compute, and take real-world actions via external tools, but reliability remains a key bottleneck. We argue that failures stem from both tool-use accuracy (how well an agent invokes a tool) and intrinsic tool accuracy (the tool's own correctness), while most prior work emphasizes the former. We introduce OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides lightweight plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites and continuous monitoring. We also release a public web demo where users can run predefined agents and tools and contribute test cases, enabling reliability reports to evolve as tools change. OpenTools includes the core framework, an initial tool set, evaluation pipelines, and a contribution protocol. Experiments and evaluations show improved end-to-end reproducibility and task performance; community-contributed, higher-quality task-specific tools deliver 6%-22% relative gains over an existing toolbox across multiple agent architectures on downstream tasks and benchmarks, highlighting the importance of intrinsic tool accuracy.

AI.tldr: OpenTools是一个社区驱动的工具箱，通过标准化工具模式、提供轻量级即插即用包装器，以及自动化测试套件和持续监控来评估工具，解决工具集成LLM的可靠性问题，强调工具内在准确性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 工具集成LLM可以通过外部工具检索、计算和执行现实世界操作，但可靠性仍然是关键瓶颈。现有研究主要关注工具使用准确性（代理如何调用工具），而忽略了工具内在准确性（工具本身的正确性），导致系统整体可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出OpenTools框架：1）标准化工具模式；2）提供轻量级即插即用包装器；3）通过自动化测试套件和持续监控评估工具；4）建立公共Web演示平台，用户可运行预定义代理和工具并贡献测试用例；5）包含核心框架、初始工具集、评估流水线和贡献协议。
AI.result: 实验评估显示：1）提高了端到端可重现性和任务性能；2）社区贡献的、更高质量的任务特定工具在多个代理架构的下游任务和基准测试中，相比现有工具箱实现了6%-22%的相对性能提升；3）验证了工具内在准确性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: OpenTools通过社区驱动的方法解决了工具集成LLM的可靠性问题，强调工具内在准确性与工具使用准确性同等重要。框架的标准化、评估和持续监控机制能够提高系统整体可靠性，社区贡献的工具质量直接影响下游任务性能。

title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation
summary: Single-agent large language model (LLM) systems struggle to simultaneously support diverse conversational functions and maintain safety in behavioral health communication. We propose a safety-aware, role-orchestrated multi-agent LLM framework designed to simulate supportive behavioral health dialogue through coordinated, role-differentiated agents. Conversational responsibilities are decomposed across specialized agents, including empathy-focused, action-oriented, and supervisory roles, while a prompt-based controller dynamically activates relevant agents and enforces continuous safety auditing. Using semi-structured interview transcripts from the DAIC-WOZ corpus, we evaluate the framework with scalable proxy metrics capturing structural quality, functional diversity, and computational characteristics. Results illustrate clear role differentiation, coherent inter-agent coordination, and predictable trade-offs between modular orchestration, safety oversight, and response latency when compared to a single-agent baseline. This work emphasizes system design, interpretability, and safety, positioning the framework as a simulation and analysis tool for behavioral health informatics and decision-support research rather than a clinical intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种安全感知、角色编排的多智能体LLM框架，通过协调的、角色分化的智能体来模拟支持性行为健康对话，解决了单智能体LLM系统在同时支持多样化对话功能和保持行为健康通信安全性方面的困难。
AI.motivation: 单智能体大型语言模型系统难以同时支持多样化的对话功能并在行为健康通信中保持安全性。需要一种能够模拟支持性行为健康对话的系统设计方法。
AI.method: 提出安全感知、角色编排的多智能体LLM框架，将对话职责分解到专门的智能体（包括共情导向、行动导向和监督角色），使用基于提示的控制器动态激活相关智能体并执行持续的安全审计。
AI.result: 使用DAIC-WOZ语料库的半结构化访谈记录进行评估，结果显示清晰的角色分化、连贯的智能体间协调，以及在模块化编排、安全监督和响应延迟之间可预测的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架强调系统设计、可解释性和安全性，定位为行为健康信息学和决策支持研究的模拟分析工具，而非临床干预手段。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Control of Objective Drift in LLM-Assisted Computer Science Education
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in computer science education through AI-assisted programming tools, yet such workflows often exhibit objective drift, in which locally plausible outputs diverge from stated task specifications. Existing instructional responses frequently emphasize tool-specific prompting practices, limiting durability as AI platforms evolve. This paper adopts a human-centered stance, treating human-in-the-loop (HITL) control as a stable educational problem rather than a transitional step toward AI autonomy. Drawing on systems engineering and control-theoretic concepts, we frame objectives and world models as operational artifacts that students configure to stabilize AI-assisted work. We propose a pilot undergraduate CS laboratory curriculum that explicitly separates planning from execution and trains students to specify acceptance criteria and architectural constraints prior to code generation. In selected labs, the curriculum also introduces deliberate, concept-aligned drift to support diagnosis and recovery from specification violations. We report a sensitivity power analysis for a three-arm pilot design comparing unstructured AI use, structured planning, and structured planning with injected drift, establishing detectable effect sizes under realistic section-level constraints. The contribution is a theory-driven, methodologically explicit foundation for HITL pedagogy that renders control competencies teachable across evolving AI tools.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于系统工程和控制理论的人类在环（HITL）教学方法，通过将目标和世界模型作为可配置的操作工件，训练学生在AI辅助编程中稳定工作流程，避免目标漂移。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在计算机科学教育中的应用日益增多，但AI辅助编程工具经常出现目标漂移问题——局部合理的输出偏离任务规范。现有的教学响应过于强调特定工具的提示工程，缺乏对AI平台演进的持久性。需要一种稳定的人类在环控制教学方法。
AI.method: 采用系统工程和控制理论概念，将目标和世界模型作为操作工件让学生配置。设计试点本科CS实验室课程，明确分离规划与执行，训练学生在代码生成前指定验收标准和架构约束。部分实验还引入故意的概念对齐漂移，以支持诊断和从规范违规中恢复。
AI.result: 进行了三组试点设计的敏感性功率分析：非结构化AI使用、结构化规划、结构化规划加注入漂移。在现实的章节级约束下建立了可检测的效应大小。为HITL教学法提供了理论驱动、方法明确的基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种将控制能力转化为可教学内容的人类在环教学框架，使控制能力能够在不断演进的AI工具中保持可教学性，为AI辅助编程教育提供了稳定且持久的方法论基础。

title: Improvisational Games as a Benchmark for Social Intelligence of AI Agents: The Case of Connections
summary: We formally introduce a improvisational wordplay game called Connections to explore reasoning capabilities of AI agents. Playing Connections combines skills in knowledge retrieval, summarization and awareness of cognitive states of other agents. We show how the game serves as a good benchmark for social intelligence abilities of language model based agents that go beyond the agents' own memory and deductive reasoning and also involve gauging the understanding capabilities of other agents. Finally, we show how through communication with other agents in a constrained environment, AI agents must demonstrate social awareness and intelligence in games involving collaboration.

AI.tldr: Connections游戏作为评估AI智能体社交推理能力的基准，要求智能体结合知识检索、总结和认知状态感知能力，在受限环境中通过协作展示社交智能。
AI.motivation: 探索AI智能体在社交推理方面的能力，超越单纯记忆和演绎推理，评估智能体如何理解其他智能体的认知状态并进行协作。
AI.method: 引入Connections即兴文字游戏作为评估框架，要求AI智能体在受限环境中与其他智能体通信，结合知识检索、总结和认知状态感知能力进行协作游戏。

title: Collaborative AI Agents and Critics for Fault Detection and Cause Analysis in Network Telemetry
summary: We develop algorithms for collaborative control of AI agents and critics in a multi-actor, multi-critic federated multi-agent system. Each AI agent and critic has access to classical machine learning or generative AI foundation models. The AI agents and critics collaborate with a central server to complete multimodal tasks such as fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in a network telemetry system, text-to-image generation, video generation, healthcare diagnostics from medical images and patient records, etcetera. The AI agents complete their tasks and send them to AI critics for evaluation. The critics then send feedback to agents to improve their responses. Collaboratively, they minimize the overall cost to the system with no inter-agent or inter-critic communication. AI agents and critics keep their cost functions or derivatives of cost functions private. Using multi-time scale stochastic approximation techniques, we provide convergence guarantees on the time-average active states of AI agents and critics. The communication overhead is a little on the system, of the order of $\mathcal{O}(m)$, for $m$ modalities and is independent of the number of AI agents and critics. Finally, we present an example of fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in network telemetry and thorough evaluation to check the algorithm's efficacy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多智能体多评论家联邦系统中的协作控制算法，AI智能体和评论家使用机器学习或生成式AI基础模型，通过中央服务器协作完成多模态任务，通过反馈机制优化性能，同时保护成本函数隐私。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体联邦系统中，需要解决AI智能体和评论家之间的协作控制问题，同时保护各参与方的隐私（成本函数），并降低通信开销。现有方法通常需要智能体间直接通信或公开成本函数，这在隐私敏感场景下不可行。
AI.method: 采用多时间尺度随机逼近技术，设计联邦多智能体多评论家系统。AI智能体完成任务后发送给评论家评估，评论家反馈改进建议。智能体和评论家保持成本函数或其导数私有，通过中央服务器协调但不直接通信。通信开销与模态数m成线性关系，与智能体和评论家数量无关。
AI.result: 提供了AI智能体和评论家时间平均活动状态的收敛保证。通信开销仅为O(m)，独立于智能体和评论家数量。在网络遥测故障检测、严重性和原因分析等示例中验证了算法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的协作控制算法能够在保护隐私的前提下，实现多智能体多评论家联邦系统的高效协作，适用于故障检测、文本到图像生成、视频生成、医疗诊断等多种多模态任务。

title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
summary: Agentic applications based on large language models increasingly rely on multi-step interaction loops involving planning, action execution, and environment feedback. While such systems are now deployed at scale, improving them post-deployment remains challenging. Agent trajectories are voluminous and non-deterministic, and reviewing each one, whether through human review or auxiliary LLMs, is slow and cost-prohibitive. We propose a lightweight, signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories. Our approach computes cheap, broadly applicable signals from live interactions and attaches them as structured attributes for trajectory triage, identifying interactions likely to be informative without affecting online agent behavior. We organize signals into a coarse-grained taxonomy spanning interaction (misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, satisfaction), execution (failure, loop), and environment (exhaustion), designed for computation without model calls. In a controlled annotation study on $τ$-bench, a widely used benchmark for tool-augmented agent evaluation, we show that signal-based sampling achieves an 82\% informativeness rate compared to 74\% for heuristic filtering and 54\% for random sampling, with a 1.52x efficiency gain per informative trajectory. The advantage is robust across reward strata and task domains, confirming that signals provide genuine per-trajectory informativeness gains rather than merely oversampling obvious failures. These results show that lightweight signals can serve as practical sampling infrastructure for agentic systems, and suggest a path toward preference data construction and post-deployment optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信号的轻量级框架，用于对基于大语言模型的智能体交互轨迹进行筛选和分类，通过计算廉价、广泛适用的信号来识别可能具有信息价值的交互，而不影响在线智能体行为。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的智能体应用越来越依赖涉及规划、行动执行和环境反馈的多步交互循环。虽然这些系统已经大规模部署，但在部署后改进它们仍然具有挑战性。智能体轨迹数量庞大且非确定性，通过人工审查或辅助LLM审查每个轨迹既缓慢又成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级、基于信号的框架，用于对智能体交互轨迹进行筛选。该方法从实时交互中计算廉价、广泛适用的信号，并将其作为结构化属性附加到轨迹上，用于识别可能具有信息价值的交互，而不影响在线智能体行为。将信号组织成一个粗粒度的分类体系，涵盖交互（错位、停滞、脱离、满意度）、执行（失败、循环）和环境（耗尽）等方面，设计为无需模型调用即可计算。
AI.result: 在τ-bench（一个广泛使用的工具增强智能体评估基准）上的受控注释研究表明，基于信号的采样实现了82%的信息率，而启发式过滤为74%，随机采样为54%，每个信息轨迹的效率增益为1.52倍。这种优势在不同奖励层级和任务领域中都具有鲁棒性，确认信号提供了真正的每轨迹信息增益，而不仅仅是过度采样明显的失败。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级信号可以作为智能体系统的实用采样基础设施，并为偏好数据构建和部署后优化提供了一条路径。

title: In harmony with gpt-oss
summary: No one has independently reproduced OpenAI's published scores for gpt-oss-20b with tools, because the original paper discloses neither the tools nor the agent harness. We reverse-engineered the model's in-distribution tools: when prompted without tool definitions, gpt-oss still calls tools from its training distribution with high statistical confidence -- a strong prior, not a hallucination. We then built a native harmony agent harness (https://github.com/borislavmavrin/harmonyagent.git) that encodes messages in the model's native format, bypassing the lossy Chat Completions conversion. Together, these yield the first independent reproduction of OpenAI's published scores: 60.4% on SWE Verified HIGH (published 60.7%), 53.3% MEDIUM (53.2%), and 91.7% on AIME25 with tools (90.4%).

AI.tldr: 研究人员首次独立复现了OpenAI发布的gpt-oss-20b模型在工具使用任务上的得分，通过逆向工程模型的训练分布工具并构建原生代理框架，验证了OpenAI的原始结果。
AI.motivation: 由于OpenAI未公开gpt-oss-20b模型使用的工具定义和代理框架，导致无人能独立复现其发布的性能得分。研究人员希望验证这些结果的可靠性。

AI.result: 成功复现了OpenAI发布的得分：SWE Verified HIGH任务60.4%（原60.7%）、MEDIUM任务53.3%（原53.2%）、AIME25任务91.7%（原90.4%），这是首次独立复现这些结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过逆向工程工具定义和构建原生代理框架，研究人员验证了OpenAI发布的gpt-oss-20b模型在工具使用任务上的性能得分的可靠性，证明了模型确实学习了训练分布中的工具使用能力。

title: Decision-Centric Design for LLM Systems
summary: LLM systems must make control decisions in addition to generating outputs: whether to answer, clarify, retrieve, call tools, repair, or escalate. In many current architectures, these decisions remain implicit within generation, entangling assessment and action in a single model call and making failures hard to inspect, constrain, or repair. We propose a decision-centric framework that separates decision-relevant signals from the policy that maps them to actions, turning control into an explicit and inspectable layer of the system. This separation supports attribution of failures to signal estimation, decision policy, or execution, and enables modular improvement of each component. It unifies familiar single-step settings such as routing and adaptive inference, and extends naturally to sequential settings in which actions alter the information available before acting. Across three controlled experiments, the framework reduces futile actions, improves task success, and reveals interpretable failure modes. More broadly, it offers a general architectural principle for building more reliable, controllable, and diagnosable LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种决策中心的LLM系统框架，将控制决策从生成中分离出来，使决策成为系统可检查和可约束的显式层，从而提高可靠性、可控性和可诊断性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM架构中，控制决策（如是否回答、澄清、检索、调用工具等）隐含在生成过程中，将评估和行动纠缠在单一模型调用中，导致故障难以检查、约束或修复。
AI.method: 提出决策中心框架，将决策相关信号与将信号映射到行动的策略分离，使控制成为系统的显式和可检查层。该分离支持将故障归因于信号估计、决策策略或执行，并支持各模块的独立改进。
AI.result: 在三个受控实验中，该框架减少了无效行动，提高了任务成功率，并揭示了可解释的故障模式。更广泛地说，它为构建更可靠、可控和可诊断的LLM系统提供了通用架构原则。
AI.conclusion: 决策中心框架通过将控制决策从生成中分离，为LLM系统提供了更可靠、可控和可诊断的架构，支持模块化改进和故障归因，统一了单步和顺序决策设置。

title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary in the MoE settings we study. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on GPT-2-scale language modeling and ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17 % higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Routing方法，无需专门的参数化路由器，直接使用token隐藏状态的指定子空间作为专家分配logits，在保持MoE层性能的同时减少参数并改善专家负载均衡。
AI.motivation: 研究在MoE设置中专门的学习路由器是否必要，探索是否可以通过更简单的方式实现有效的专家分配，减少模型参数并简化架构。
AI.method: 提出Self-Routing方法：1) 消除专用的路由器投影层；2) 使用token隐藏状态的指定子空间直接作为专家logits；3) 保持MoE层其他部分不变；4) 在GPT-2规模的语言建模和ImageNet-1K分类任务上评估。
AI.result: Self-Routing与标准学习路由器基线保持竞争力，同时移除所有专用路由参数，专家利用率更均衡（平均归一化路由熵提高约17%），无需显式负载均衡损失。在ImageNet-1K上使用DeiT-S/16时，Self-Routing甚至略微优于对应的学习路由器MoE。
AI.conclusion: 有效的MoE路由可以从隐藏表示本身涌现，无需单独的学习路由器模块，这简化了MoE架构并减少了参数。

title: Execution-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating optimization modeling with LLMs is a promising path toward scalable decision intelligence, but existing approaches either rely on agentic pipelines built on closed-source LLMs with high inference latency, or fine-tune smaller LLMs using costly process supervision that often overfits to a single solver API. Inspired by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, we propose Execution-Verified Optimization Modeling (EVOM), an execution-verified learning framework that treats a mathematical programming solver as a deterministic, interactive verifier. Given a natural-language problem and a target solver, EVOM generates solver-specific code, executes it in a sandboxed harness, and converts execution outcomes into scalar rewards, optimized with GRPO and DAPO in a closed-loop generate-execute-feedback-update process. This outcome-only formulation removes the need for process-level supervision, and enables cross-solver generalization by switching the verification environment rather than reconstructing solver-specific datasets. Experiments on NL4OPT, MAMO, IndustryOR, and OptiBench across Gurobi, OR-Tools, and COPT show that EVOM matches or outperforms process-supervised SFT, supports zero-shot solver transfer, and achieves effective low-cost solver adaptation by continuing training under the target solver backend.

AI.motivation: 现有优化建模自动化方法要么依赖高延迟的闭源LLMs代理管道，要么使用昂贵的过程监督微调小型LLMs，容易过拟合到单一求解器API。需要一种更高效、可泛化的方法。
AI.method: 提出执行验证优化建模（EVOM）框架，将数学规划求解器作为确定性交互验证器。给定自然语言问题和目标求解器，生成求解器特定代码，在沙箱环境中执行，将执行结果转换为标量奖励，使用GRPO和DAPO在闭环生成-执行-反馈-更新过程中进行优化。
AI.result: 在NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR和OptiBench数据集上，使用Gurobi、OR-Tools和COPT求解器的实验表明，EVOM匹配或优于过程监督的SFT，支持零样本求解器迁移，并通过在目标求解器后端继续训练实现有效的低成本求解器适应。
AI.conclusion: EVOM通过执行验证学习框架，消除了过程级监督的需求，通过切换验证环境而非重建求解器特定数据集，实现了跨求解器泛化，为可扩展决策智能提供了有效路径。

title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimation (UE) aims to detect hallucinated outputs of large language models (LLMs) to improve their reliability. However, UE metrics often exhibit unstable performance across configurations, which significantly limits their applicability. In this work, we formalise this phenomenon as proxy failure, since most UE metrics originate from model behaviour, rather than being explicitly grounded in the factual correctness of LLM outputs. With this, we show that UE metrics become non-discriminative precisely in low-information regimes. To alleviate this, we propose Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method to remedy UE metrics, by mapping the raw scores to truth-aligned scores. Even with noisy and few-shot supervision, our TAC can support the learning of well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, and presents a practical calibration protocol. Our findings highlight the limitations of treating heuristic UE metrics as direct indicators of truth uncertainty, and position our TAC as a necessary step toward more reliable uncertainty estimation for LLMs. The code repository is available at https://github.com/ponhvoan/TruthAnchor/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Truth AnChoring (TAC)方法，通过将原始不确定性估计分数映射到与事实对齐的分数，解决LLM不确定性估计指标在不同配置下性能不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的不确定性估计指标经常在不同配置下表现出不稳定的性能，这限制了它们的实际应用。作者将这种现象形式化为"代理失败"，因为大多数不确定性估计指标源于模型行为，而不是明确基于LLM输出的事实正确性。
AI.method: 提出Truth AnChoring (TAC)方法，这是一种后处理校准方法，通过将原始不确定性估计分数映射到与事实对齐的分数来修复不确定性估计指标。即使在噪声和少样本监督下，TAC也能支持学习良好校准的不确定性估计。
AI.result: TAC能够支持学习良好校准的不确定性估计，并提出实用的校准协议。该方法在低信息区域特别有效，解决了不确定性估计指标在该区域变得不可区分的问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了将启发式不确定性估计指标直接视为真实不确定性指标的局限性，并将TAC定位为实现LLM更可靠不确定性估计的必要步骤。

title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation
summary: LLM-based agent judges are an emerging approach to evaluating conversational AI, yet a fundamental uncertainty remains: can we trust their assessments, and if so, how many are needed? Through 960 sessions with two model pairs across 15 tasks, we show that persona-based agent judges produce evaluations indistinguishable from human raters in a Turing-style validation. We then identify a score-coverage dissociation: quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size, while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law-both exhibit diminishing returns, but scores saturate roughly twice as fast as discoveries. We hypothesize this reflects a power law distribution of the finding space: critical issues are discovered first by small panels, while corner cases require progressively larger panels, analogous to species accumulation curves in ecology. The mechanism traces to ensemble diversity-Big Five personality conditioning makes agents probe different quality dimensions, with expert judges acting as adversarial probes that push discovery into the tail of the finding distribution. A controlled ablation confirms that structured persona conditioning, not simple prompting, is required to produce these scaling properties.

AI.tldr: 本文通过960次会话实验验证了基于LLM的代理评委在对话AI评估中的可靠性，发现人格化代理评委的评估与人类评分者无法区分，并揭示了评分与问题发现之间的分离现象：评分随评委数量对数增长而饱和，而独特问题发现遵循亚线性幂律分布。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的代理评委在对话AI评估中应用日益广泛，但存在一个基本不确定性：我们能否信任这些评估？如果需要信任，需要多少评委才能获得可靠结果？本研究旨在通过系统性实验验证代理评委的可靠性，并探索评委数量与评估质量之间的关系。
AI.method: 研究进行了960次会话实验，涉及两个模型对在15个任务上的评估。采用图灵式验证方法比较人格化代理评委与人类评分者的评估结果。通过控制实验分析评委数量对评分质量和问题发现的影响，特别关注大五人格条件化对评委多样性的作用。
AI.result: 1. 人格化代理评委的评估与人类评分者无法区分；2. 发现评分-覆盖率分离现象：质量评分随评委数量对数增长而饱和，而独特问题发现遵循亚线性幂律分布；3. 评分饱和速度约为问题发现饱和速度的两倍；4. 结构化人格条件化（而非简单提示）是实现这些缩放特性的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的人格化代理评委能够产生与人类相当的评估，但评估质量与评委数量之间存在复杂关系。关键问题可由小评委组发现，而边缘案例需要更大评委组，这类似于生态学中的物种积累曲线。结构化人格条件化是实现有效评委多样性的关键机制。

title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation data available at https://github.com/Helephants/langgraph-layered-context
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly prioritize user validation over epistemic accuracy-a phenomenon known as sycophancy. We present The Silicon Mirror, an orchestration framework that dynamically detects user persuasion tactics and adjusts AI behavior to maintain factual integrity. Our architecture introduces three components: (1) a Behavioral Access Control (BAC) system that restricts context layer access based on real-time sycophancy risk scores, (2) a Trait Classifier that identifies persuasion tactics across multi-turn dialogues, and (3) a Generator-Critic loop where an auditor vetoes sycophantic drafts and triggers rewrites with "Necessary Friction." In a live evaluation on 50 TruthfulQA adversarial scenarios using Claude Sonnet 4 with an independent LLM judge, we observe vanilla Claude sycophancy at 12.0% (6/50), static guardrails at 4.0% (2/50), and the Silicon Mirror at 2.0% (1/50)-an 83.3% relative reduction (p = 0.112, Fisher's exact test). A cross-model evaluation on Gemini 2.5 Flash reveals a higher baseline sycophancy rate (46.0%) and a statistically significant 69.6% reduction under the Silicon Mirror (p < 0.001). We characterize the validation-before-correction pattern as a distinct failure mode of RLHF-trained models.

AI.tldr: The Silicon Mirror是一个动态检测用户说服策略并调整AI行为以保持事实完整性的编排框架，通过行为访问控制、特质分类器和生成器-批评家循环，显著降低了LLM的谄媚行为。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越倾向于用户验证而非认知准确性，这种现象被称为谄媚行为。现有方法无法有效处理多轮对话中的动态说服策略，需要一种能够实时检测和调整AI行为的框架来保持事实完整性。
AI.method: 提出了The Silicon Mirror框架，包含三个核心组件：1）基于实时谄媚风险评分限制上下文层访问的行为访问控制系统；2）在多轮对话中识别说服策略的特质分类器；3）生成器-批评家循环，审计员否决谄媚草稿并触发带有"必要摩擦"的重写。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA对抗场景评估中，Claude Sonnet 4的谄媚率从12.0%降至2.0%（相对减少83.3%）；Gemini 2.5 Flash的谄媚率从46.0%显著降低69.6%（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: The Silicon Mirror框架能有效降低LLM的谄媚行为，识别了RLHF训练模型的验证-纠正模式失败机制，为保持AI事实完整性提供了系统化解决方案。

title: Adaptive Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient Test-time Compute Scaling
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is an effective test-time compute scaling (TTCS) method for improving the reasoning performance of large language models, but its highly variable execution time leads to severe long-tail latency in practice. Existing optimizations such as positive early exit, reduce latency in favorable cases but are less effective when search continues without meaningful progress. We introduce {\it negative early exit}, which prunes unproductive MCTS trajectories, and an {\it adaptive boosting mechanism} that reallocates reclaimed computation to reduce resource contention among concurrent searches. Integrated into vLLM, these techniques substantially reduce p99 end-to-end latency while improving throughput and maintaining reasoning accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出负向提前退出和自适应增强机制来优化MCTS推理延迟，在保持准确性的同时显著降低p99延迟并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: MCTS作为有效的测试时计算扩展方法，在实际应用中存在执行时间高度可变的问题，导致严重的尾部延迟。现有优化方法如正向提前退出在有利情况下能减少延迟，但在搜索无意义进展时效果有限。
AI.method: 提出负向提前退出机制来剪枝无生产力的MCTS轨迹，以及自适应增强机制重新分配回收的计算资源以减少并发搜索间的资源竞争。这些技术集成到vLLM框架中。
AI.result: 这些技术显著降低了p99端到端延迟，同时提高了吞吐量并保持了推理准确性。
AI.conclusion: 负向提前退出和自适应增强机制是优化MCTS推理延迟的有效方法，能够在保持性能的同时改善实际部署中的延迟特性。

title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models
summary: Unified Multimodal Large Models (UMLMs) integrate understanding and generation capabilities within a single architecture. While this architectural unification, driven by the deep fusion of multimodal features, enhances model performance, it also introduces important yet underexplored safety challenges. Existing safety benchmarks predominantly focus on isolated understanding or generation tasks, failing to evaluate the holistic safety of UMLMs when handling diverse tasks under a unified framework. To address this, we introduce Uni-SafeBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring a taxonomy of six major safety categories across seven task types. To ensure rigorous assessment, we develop Uni-Judger, a framework that effectively decouples contextual safety from intrinsic safety. Based on comprehensive evaluations across Uni-SafeBench, we uncover that while the unification process enhances model capabilities, it significantly degrades the inherent safety of the underlying LLM. Furthermore, open-source UMLMs exhibit much lower safety performance than multimodal large models specialized for either generation or understanding tasks. We open-source all resources to systematically expose these risks and foster safer AGI development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Uni-SafeBench基准测试，用于评估统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）在统一架构下的安全性问题，发现模型统一化虽然提升了能力但显著降低了安全性。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）将理解和生成能力集成在单一架构中，这种架构统一虽然通过多模态特征的深度融合提升了模型性能，但也引入了重要但未被充分探索的安全挑战。现有的安全基准主要关注孤立的理解或生成任务，无法评估UMLMs在统一框架下处理多样化任务时的整体安全性。
AI.method: 提出了Uni-SafeBench，一个包含六个主要安全类别和七种任务类型的综合基准测试。开发了Uni-Judger框架，有效解耦上下文安全性和内在安全性，确保严格评估。基于Uni-SafeBench进行全面评估，分析UMLMs的安全性能。
AI.result: 评估发现：1）统一化过程虽然增强了模型能力，但显著降低了底层LLM的内在安全性；2）开源UMLMs的安全性表现远低于专门用于生成或理解任务的多模态大模型。
AI.conclusion: UMLMs的统一架构带来了新的安全挑战，需要系统性的安全评估框架。开源所有资源以系统性地暴露这些风险，促进更安全的AGI发展。

title: BloClaw: An Omniscient, Multi-Modal Agentic Workspace for Next-Generation Scientific Discovery
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into life sciences has catalyzed the development of "AI Scientists." However, translating these theoretical capabilities into deployment-ready research environments exposes profound infrastructural vulnerabilities. Current frameworks are bottlenecked by fragile JSON-based tool-calling protocols, easily disrupted execution sandboxes that lose graphical outputs, and rigid conversational interfaces inherently ill-suited for high-dimensional scientific data.We introduce BloClaw, a unified, multi-modal operating system designed for Artificial Intelligence for Science (AI4S). BloClaw reconstructs the Agent-Computer Interaction (ACI) paradigm through three architectural innovations: (1) An XML-Regex Dual-Track Routing Protocol that statistically eliminates serialization failures (0.2% error rate vs. 17.6% in JSON); (2) A Runtime State Interception Sandbox that utilizes Python monkey-patching to autonomously capture and compile dynamic data visualizations (Plotly/Matplotlib), circumventing browser CORS policies; and (3) A State-Driven Dynamic Viewport UI that morphs seamlessly between a minimalist command deck and an interactive spatial rendering engine. We comprehensively benchmark BloClaw across cheminformatics (RDKit), de novo 3D protein folding via ESMFold, molecular docking, and autonomous Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), establishing a highly robust, self-evolving paradigm for computational research assistants. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/qinheming/BloClaw.

AI.tldr: BloClaw是一个为AI4S设计的统一多模态操作系统，通过XML-Regex双轨路由协议、运行时状态拦截沙箱和状态驱动动态视口UI三大创新，解决了现有AI科学家框架在工具调用、图形输出和科学数据交互方面的基础设施脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前将大语言模型集成到生命科学中的"AI科学家"框架存在严重的基础设施脆弱性问题：基于JSON的工具调用协议容易失败，执行沙箱容易丢失图形输出，以及对话界面不适合处理高维科学数据。这些问题阻碍了AI科学家从理论能力向实际部署环境的转化。
AI.method: BloClaw通过三大架构创新重构了Agent-Computer Interaction范式：1) XML-Regex双轨路由协议，统计上消除序列化失败；2) 运行时状态拦截沙箱，利用Python monkey-patching自动捕获和编译动态数据可视化；3) 状态驱动动态视口UI，在简约命令面板和交互式空间渲染引擎之间无缝切换。
AI.result: BloClaw在化学信息学、从头3D蛋白质折叠、分子对接和自主检索增强生成等多个领域进行了全面基准测试，XML-Regex协议的错误率仅为0.2%，远低于JSON协议的17.6%，建立了高度稳健、自我演化的计算研究助手范式。
AI.conclusion: BloClaw为AI4S提供了一个统一的多模态操作系统，通过创新的架构设计解决了现有框架的基础设施脆弱性问题，为计算研究助手建立了高度稳健、自我演化的新范式，推动了AI科学家从理论能力向实际部署环境的转化。

title: Ontology-Constrained Neural Reasoning in Enterprise Agentic Systems: A Neurosymbolic Architecture for Domain-Grounded AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 7 tables, 4 figures, 33 references. Empirical evaluation: 600 runs across 5 regulated industries including Vietnamese-language domains
summary: Enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by hallucination, domain drift, and the inability to enforce regulatory compliance at the reasoning level. We present a neurosymbolic architecture implemented within the Foundation AgenticOS (FAOS) platform that addresses these limitations through ontology-constrained neural reasoning. Our approach introduces a three-layer ontological framework--Role, Domain, and Interaction ontologies--that provides formal semantic grounding for LLM-based enterprise agents. We formalize the concept of asymmetric neurosymbolic coupling, wherein symbolic ontological knowledge constrains agent inputs (context assembly, tool discovery, governance thresholds) while proposing mechanisms for extending this coupling to constrain agent outputs (response validation, reasoning verification, compliance checking). We evaluate the architecture through a controlled experiment (600 runs across five industries: FinTech, Insurance, Healthcare, Vietnamese Banking, and Vietnamese Insurance), finding that ontology-coupled agents significantly outperform ungrounded agents on Metric Accuracy (p < .001, W = .460), Regulatory Compliance (p = .003, W = .318), and Role Consistency (p < .001, W = .614), with improvements greatest where LLM parametric knowledge is weakest--particularly in Vietnam-localized domains. Our contributions include: (1) a formal three-layer enterprise ontology model, (2) a taxonomy of neurosymbolic coupling patterns, (3) ontology-constrained tool discovery via SQL-pushdown scoring, (4) a proposed framework for output-side ontological validation, (5) empirical evidence for the inverse parametric knowledge effect that ontological grounding value is inversely proportional to LLM training data coverage of the domain, and (6) a production system serving 21 industry verticals with 650+ agents.

AI.tldr: FAOS平台采用神经符号架构，通过三层本体框架约束LLM企业代理，显著提升准确性、合规性和角色一致性，尤其在LLM参数知识薄弱的领域效果更佳。
AI.motivation: 企业采用大型语言模型面临幻觉、领域漂移和无法在推理层面执行监管合规等限制，需要一种能够约束LLM推理的神经符号架构来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 在FAOS平台中实现神经符号架构，引入三层本体框架（角色、领域、交互本体），采用非对称神经符号耦合方法，通过符号本体知识约束代理输入，并提出扩展到约束代理输出的机制。
AI.result: 在五个行业（金融科技、保险、医疗、越南银行、越南保险）的600次实验运行中，本体耦合代理在度量准确性、监管合规性和角色一致性方面显著优于未接地代理，尤其在LLM参数知识最薄弱的越南本地化领域改进最大。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号架构通过本体约束的神经推理有效解决了LLM在企业应用中的关键限制，提供了可扩展的生产系统，已在21个行业垂直领域部署650+个代理。

title: Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks
summary: As the focus in LLM-based coding shifts from static single-step code generation to multi-step agentic interaction with tools and environments, understanding which tasks will challenge agents and why becomes increasingly difficult. This is compounded by current practice: agent performance is typically measured by aggregate pass rates on benchmarks, but single-number metrics obscure the diversity of tasks within a benchmark. We present a framework for predicting success or failure on individual tasks tailored to the agentic coding regime. Our approach augments Item Response Theory (IRT) with rich features extracted from tasks, including issue statements, repository contexts, solutions, and test cases, and introduces a novel decomposition of agent ability into LLM and scaffold ability components. This parameterization enables us to aggregate evaluation data across heterogeneous leaderboards and accurately predict task-level performance for unseen benchmarks, as well as unseen LLM-scaffold combinations. Our methods have practical utility for benchmark designers, who can better calibrate the difficulty of their new tasks without running computationally expensive agent evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个预测智能体编码任务成功率的框架，结合项目反应理论和任务特征，将智能体能力分解为LLM能力和脚手架能力，实现跨基准和LLM-脚手架组合的性能预测。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM编码从静态单步生成转向多步工具交互，理解哪些任务会挑战智能体变得困难。当前实践仅通过基准测试的聚合通过率衡量性能，但单一指标掩盖了任务多样性，需要更细粒度的预测方法。
AI.method: 扩展项目反应理论（IRT），从任务中提取丰富特征（问题陈述、仓库上下文、解决方案、测试用例），引入智能体能力分解为LLM能力和脚手架能力组件，实现跨异构排行榜的数据聚合。
AI.result: 能够准确预测未见基准测试的任务级性能，以及未见LLM-脚手架组合的性能，为基准设计者提供实用工具，无需运行昂贵的智能体评估即可校准新任务难度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为智能体编码评估提供了更细粒度的预测能力，解决了当前基准测试的局限性，使基准设计者能够更有效地设计和校准任务难度。

title: CircuitProbe: Predicting Reasoning Circuits in Transformers via Stability Zone Detection
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code available at https://github.com/agenticclass/circuitprobe
summary: Transformer language models contain localized reasoning circuits, contiguous layer blocks that improve reasoning when duplicated at inference time. Finding these circuits currently requires brute-force sweeps costing 25 GPU hours per model. We propose CircuitProbe, which predicts circuit locations from activation statistics in under 5 minutes on CPU, providing a speedup of three to four orders of magnitude. We find that reasoning circuits come in two types: stability circuits in early layers, detected through the derivative of representation change, and magnitude circuits in late layers, detected through anomaly scoring. We validate across 9 models spanning 6 architectures, including 2025 models, confirming that CircuitProbe top predictions match or are within 2 layers of the optimal circuit in all validated cases. A scaling experiment across the Qwen 2.5 family reveals that layer duplication consistently benefits models under 3B parameters but degrades performance in 7B+ models, making this a practical scaling technique for small language models. CircuitProbe requires as few as 10 calibration examples and its predictions are stable across English, Hindi, Chinese, and French.

AI.tldr: CircuitProbe是一种快速预测Transformer语言模型中推理电路位置的方法，通过激活统计在CPU上5分钟内完成，相比传统暴力搜索方法提速3-4个数量级，发现推理电路分为早期稳定性电路和晚期幅度电路两种类型。
AI.motivation: 当前寻找Transformer语言模型中的推理电路需要耗费大量计算资源（每个模型25 GPU小时），这限制了电路发现和优化的效率。需要一种快速、高效的方法来定位这些推理电路，以便更好地理解和优化语言模型的推理能力。
AI.method: CircuitProbe通过分析激活统计来预测电路位置：1）早期层的稳定性电路通过表示变化的导数检测；2）晚期层的幅度电路通过异常评分检测。该方法仅需10个校准样本，在CPU上5分钟内完成预测，支持多语言验证。
AI.result: 在9个模型（涵盖6种架构，包括2025年模型）上验证，CircuitProbe的预测结果与最优电路匹配或在2层范围内。在Qwen 2.5家族上的扩展实验显示，层复制对3B参数以下模型有益，但对7B+模型性能下降。
AI.conclusion: CircuitProbe提供了一种快速高效的推理电路定位方法，显著降低了电路发现的计算成本，揭示了推理电路的两种类型及其在不同规模模型中的适用性，为小型语言模型的优化提供了实用技术。

title: UK AISI Alignment Evaluation Case-Study
summary: This technical report presents methods developed by the UK AI Security Institute for assessing whether advanced AI systems reliably follow intended goals. Specifically, we evaluate whether frontier models sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants within an AI lab. Applying our methods to four frontier models, we find no confirmed instances of research sabotage. However, we observe that Claude Opus 4.5 Preview (a pre-release snapshot of Opus 4.5) and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refuse to engage with safety-relevant research tasks, citing concerns about research direction, involvement in self-training, and research scope. We additionally find that Opus 4.5 Preview shows reduced unprompted evaluation awareness compared to Sonnet 4.5, while both models can distinguish evaluation from deployment scenarios when prompted. Our evaluation framework builds on Petri, an open-source LLM auditing tool, with a custom scaffold designed to simulate realistic internal deployment of a coding agent. We validate that this scaffold produces trajectories that all tested models fail to reliably distinguish from real deployment data. We test models across scenarios varying in research motivation, activity type, replacement threat, and model autonomy. Finally, we discuss limitations including scenario coverage and evaluation awareness.

AI.motivation: 评估先进AI系统在作为编码助手部署时是否可靠遵循预期目标，特别是检测是否存在研究破坏行为，确保AI系统在AI实验室环境中的安全使用。

AI.result: 对四个前沿模型的评估未发现确认的研究破坏实例。但Claude Opus 4.5 Preview和Sonnet 4.5经常拒绝参与安全相关研究任务，理由是研究方向、自训练参与和研究范围等担忧。Opus 4.5 Preview相比Sonnet 4.5显示出减少的无提示评估意识。

title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning
summary: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex reasoning tasks such as competitive programming (CP), existing methods predominantly focus on single-attempt settings, overlooking their capacity for iterative refinement. In this paper, we present RefineRL, a novel approach designed to unleash the self-refinement capabilities of LLMs for CP problem solving. RefineRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Skeptical-Agent, an iterative self-refinement agent equipped with local execution tools to validate generated solutions against public test cases of CP problems. This agent always maintains a skeptical attitude towards its own outputs and thereby enforces rigorous self-refinement even when validation suggests correctness. (2) A reinforcement learning (RL) solution to incentivize LLMs to self-refine with only standard RLVR data (i.e., problems paired with their verifiable answers). Extensive experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-2507 demonstrate that our method yields substantial gains: after our RL training, these compact 4B models integrated with the Skeptical-Agent not only outperform much larger 32B models but also approach the single-attempt performance of 235B models. These findings suggest that self-refinement holds considerable promise for scaling LLM reasoning, with significant potential for further advancement.

AI.tldr: RefineRL是一种新颖的方法，通过结合怀疑代理和强化学习来释放LLM在竞争性编程问题中的自我优化能力，使小型4B模型能够超越大型32B模型并接近235B模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型方法主要关注单次尝试设置，忽视了它们在竞争性编程问题中迭代优化的潜力。本文旨在开发一种能够充分利用LLM自我优化能力的方法，使小型模型能够通过迭代优化达到甚至超越大型模型的性能。
AI.method: RefineRL包含两个关键创新：1) Skeptical-Agent（怀疑代理）- 配备本地执行工具的迭代自我优化代理，用于验证生成的解决方案是否符合CP问题的公共测试用例；2) 强化学习解决方案 - 激励LLM仅使用标准RLVR数据进行自我优化。该方法在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-4B-2507模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 经过RL训练后，配备Skeptical-Agent的4B紧凑模型不仅超越了更大的32B模型，还接近了235B模型的单次尝试性能。这表明自我优化在扩展LLM推理方面具有显著潜力。
AI.conclusion: 自我优化对于扩展LLM推理具有相当大的前景，具有显著的进一步进步潜力。RefineRL方法通过结合怀疑代理和强化学习，成功释放了LLM在竞争性编程问题中的自我优化能力。

title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning
summary: We propose the Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation (PG-IPRO) for urban route planning for people with different accessibility requirements and preferences. With this algorithm the user can interact with the system by giving feedback on a route, i.e., the user can say which objective should be further minimized, or conversely can be relaxed. This leads to intuitive user interaction, that is especially effective during early iterations compared to information-gain-based interaction. Furthermore, due to PG-IPRO's iterative nature, the full set of alternative, possibly optimal policies (the Pareto front), is never computed, leading to higher computational efficiency and shorter waiting times for users.

AI.tldr: PG-IPRO算法用于为不同无障碍需求的人群进行城市路线规划，通过用户反馈交互优化路线，避免计算完整的帕累托前沿，提高计算效率和用户体验。
AI.motivation: 现有城市路线规划系统难以满足不同人群的无障碍需求，特别是对于有特殊移动需求的人群。传统方法要么计算完整的帕累托前沿（计算量大），要么交互方式不够直观。需要一种既能提供个性化路线，又能高效交互的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出偏好引导迭代帕累托参考优化（PG-IPRO）算法：1）用户通过反馈与系统交互，指定哪些目标需要进一步最小化或可以放宽；2）采用迭代方式，避免计算完整的帕累托前沿；3）基于用户偏好逐步优化路线策略。
AI.result: PG-IPRO实现了直观的用户交互，特别是在早期迭代中比基于信息增益的交互更有效。由于不计算完整的帕累托前沿，算法具有更高的计算效率，缩短了用户等待时间。
AI.conclusion: PG-IPRO为具有不同无障碍需求和偏好的用户提供了一种高效、直观的城市路线规划方法，通过迭代优化和用户反馈机制，在计算效率和用户体验之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
summary: Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.

AI.tldr: 提出了Pare框架，用于在数字环境中构建和评估主动代理，通过有限状态机建模应用状态，并创建了包含143个任务的基准测试Pare-Bench。
AI.motivation: 当前主动代理的发展受到缺乏真实用户模拟框架的限制。现有方法将应用建模为扁平的工具调用API，无法捕捉数字环境中用户交互的状态性和顺序性，导致真实用户模拟不可行。
AI.method: 引入Pare框架，将应用程序建模为有限状态机，具有状态导航和状态依赖的动作空间，支持主动用户模拟。在此基础上创建Pare-Bench基准测试，包含143个跨通信、生产力、日程安排和生活方式应用的任务。
AI.result: 开发了Pare框架和Pare-Bench基准测试，能够测试上下文观察、目标推断、干预时机和多应用协调等能力，为主动代理的研究提供了实用的评估环境。
AI.conclusion: Pare框架通过状态机建模解决了现有用户模拟方法的局限性，为主动代理的开发和评估提供了更真实的数字环境模拟，推动了智能助手技术的发展。

title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Geometric Problem Solving (GPS) remains at the heart of enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models because it requires the combination of diagrammatic understanding, symbolic manipulation and logical inference. In existing literature, researchers have chiefly focused on synchronising the diagram descriptions with text literals and solving the problem. In this vein, they have either taken a neural, symbolic or neuro-symbolic approach. But this solves only the first two of the requirements, namely diagrammatic understanding and symbolic manipulation, while leaving logical inference underdeveloped. The logical inference is often limited to one chain-of-thought (CoT). To address this weakness in hitherto existing models, this paper proposes MARS-GPS, that generates multiple parallel reasoning rollouts augmented with Python code execution for numerical verification, ranks them using token-level entropy as a confidence signal, and aggregates answers through a multi-stage voting and self-verification pipeline. Empirical results show that MARS-GPS with 8 parallel rollouts achieves 88.8% on Geometry3K, a nearly +11% improvement over the prior state-of-the-art, with accuracy scaling consistently as the number of rollouts increases from 1 to 16 (+6.0% on ablation subset). We provide our code and data in an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55.

AI.tldr: MARS-GPS提出了一种用于几何问题求解的新方法，通过生成多个并行推理路径、使用Python代码进行数值验证、基于熵的置信度排名以及多阶段投票自验证管道，显著提升了逻辑推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有几何问题求解方法主要关注图表描述与文本的同步以及问题求解，但通常只解决了图表理解和符号操作两个需求，而逻辑推理能力不足，往往仅限于单一思维链推理。
AI.method: 提出MARS-GPS方法：1）生成多个并行推理路径；2）使用Python代码执行进行数值验证；3）基于标记级熵作为置信信号进行排名；4）通过多阶段投票和自验证管道聚合答案。
AI.result: 在Geometry3K数据集上，使用8个并行推理路径的MARS-GPS达到88.8%的准确率，比先前最先进方法提升近11%。当推理路径数量从1增加到16时，准确率持续提升（在消融子集上提升6.0%）。
AI.conclusion: MARS-GPS通过并行推理路径生成、数值验证和基于熵的排名机制，有效解决了几何问题求解中逻辑推理不足的问题，显著提升了数学推理能力。

title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts
summary: Multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), wherein each agent takes on a specific role, supports hard queries that require multiple steps and sources, or complex reasoning. Existing approaches, however, rely on static agent behaviors and fixed orchestration strategies, leading to brittle performance on diverse, multi-hop tasks. We identify two key limitations: the lack of continuously adaptive orchestration mechanisms and the absence of behavior-level learning for individual agents. To this end, we propose HERA, a hierarchical framework that jointly evolves multi-agent orchestration and role-specific agent prompts. At the global level, HERA optimizes query-specific agent topologies through reward-guided sampling and experience accumulation. At the local level, Role-Aware Prompt Evolution refines agent behaviors via credit assignment and dual-axes adaptation along operational and behavioral principles, enabling targeted, role-conditioned improvements. On six knowledge-intensive benchmarks, HERA achieves an average improvement of 38.69\% over recent baselines while maintaining robust generalization and token efficiency. Topological analyses reveal emergent self-organization, where sparse exploration yields compact, high-utility multi-agent networks, demonstrating both efficient coordination and robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: HERA提出了一种分层框架，通过联合演化多智能体编排和角色特定提示来解决现有多智能体RAG方法在多样化多跳任务上的性能脆弱问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体RAG方法依赖静态智能体行为和固定编排策略，导致在多样化、多跳任务上的性能脆弱。主要存在两个关键限制：缺乏持续自适应编排机制，以及缺乏个体智能体行为级学习。
AI.method: HERA采用分层框架：在全局层面，通过奖励引导采样和经验积累优化查询特定的智能体拓扑；在局部层面，通过角色感知提示演化，利用信用分配和沿操作与行为原则的双轴适应来细化智能体行为。
AI.result: 在六个知识密集型基准测试中，HERA相比近期基线平均提升38.69%，同时保持鲁棒泛化能力和令牌效率。拓扑分析揭示了新兴的自组织现象，稀疏探索产生紧凑、高实用性的多智能体网络。
AI.conclusion: HERA通过联合演化多智能体编排和角色特定提示，实现了高效协调和鲁棒推理，解决了现有方法在多样化多跳任务上的性能脆弱问题。

title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor
summary: Existing methods for AI psychological counselors predominantly rely on supervised fine-tuning using static dialogue datasets. However, this contrasts with human experts, who continuously refine their proficiency through clinical practice and accumulated experience. To bridge this gap, we propose an Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent (\texttt{PsychAgent}) for psychological counseling. First, we establish a Memory-Augmented Planning Engine tailored for longitudinal multi-session interactions, which ensures therapeutic continuity through persistent memory and strategic planning. Second, to support self-evolution, we design a Skill Evolution Engine that extracts new practice-grounded skills from historical counseling trajectories. Finally, we introduce a Reinforced Internalization Engine that integrates the evolved skills into the model via rejection fine-tuning, aiming to improve performance across diverse scenarios. Comparative analysis shows that our approach achieves higher scores than strong general LLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4, Gemini-3) and domain-specific baselines across all reported evaluation dimensions. These results suggest that lifelong learning can improve the consistency and overall quality of multi-session counseling responses.

AI.tldr: 提出PsychAgent，一个经验驱动的终身学习AI心理咨询代理，通过记忆增强规划引擎、技能进化引擎和强化内化引擎实现持续自我进化，在多轮心理咨询中表现优于通用大模型和领域基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AI心理咨询方法主要依赖静态对话数据集进行监督微调，这与人类专家通过临床实践和经验积累持续提升能力的方式形成鲜明对比。需要弥合这一差距，使AI心理咨询代理能够像人类专家一样通过实践经验不断进化。
AI.method: 1. 记忆增强规划引擎：针对纵向多会话交互设计，通过持久记忆和战略规划确保治疗连续性。2. 技能进化引擎：从历史咨询轨迹中提取基于实践的新技能。3. 强化内化引擎：通过拒绝微调将进化技能整合到模型中，提升多样化场景下的性能。
AI.result: 比较分析显示，该方法在所有报告评估维度上均优于强大的通用大模型（如GPT-5.4、Gemini-3）和领域特定基线。结果表明终身学习能够提高多会话咨询响应的一致性和整体质量。
AI.conclusion: 经验驱动的终身学习方法能够有效提升AI心理咨询代理的能力，使其能够像人类专家一样通过实践经验持续进化，在多轮心理咨询中提供更一致和高质量的响应。

title: OmniMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: AI agents increasingly operate over extended time horizons, yet their ability to retain, organize, and recall multimodal experiences remains a critical bottleneck. Building effective lifelong memory requires navigating a vast design space spanning architecture, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, and data pipelines; this space is too large and interconnected for manual exploration or traditional AutoML to explore effectively. We deploy an autonomous research pipeline to discover OmniMem, a unified multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents. Starting from a naïve baseline (F1=0.117 on LoCoMo), the pipeline autonomously executes ${\sim}50$ experiments across two benchmarks, diagnosing failure modes, proposing architectural modifications, and repairing data pipeline bugs, all without human intervention in the inner loop. The resulting system achieves state-of-the-art on both benchmarks, improving F1 by +411% on LoCoMo (0.117$\to$0.598) and +214% on Mem-Gallery (0.254$\to$0.797) relative to the initial configurations. Critically, the most impactful discoveries are not hyperparameter adjustments: bug fixes (+175%), architectural changes (+44%), and prompt engineering (+188\% on specific categories) each individually exceed the cumulative contribution of all hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating capabilities fundamentally beyond the reach of traditional AutoML. We provide a taxonomy of six discovery types and identify four properties that make multimodal memory particularly suited for autoresearch, offering guidance for applying autonomous research pipelines to other AI system domains. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/OmniMem.

title: Adversarial Moral Stress Testing of Large Language Models
summary: Evaluating the ethical robustness of large language models (LLMs) deployed in software systems remains challenging, particularly under sustained adversarial user interaction. Existing safety benchmarks typically rely on single-round evaluations and aggregate metrics, such as toxicity scores and refusal rates, which offer limited visibility into behavioral instability that may arise during realistic multi-turn interactions. As a result, rare but high-impact ethical failures and progressive degradation effects may remain undetected prior to deployment. This paper introduces Adversarial Moral Stress Testing (AMST), a stress-based evaluation framework for assessing ethical robustness under adversarial multi-round interactions. AMST applies structured stress transformations to prompts and evaluates model behavior through distribution-aware robustness metrics that capture variance, tail risk, and temporal behavioral drift across interaction rounds. We evaluate AMST on several state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA-3-8B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-v3, using a large set of adversarial scenarios generated under controlled stress conditions. The results demonstrate substantial differences in robustness profiles across models and expose degradation patterns that are not observable under conventional single-round evaluation protocols. In particular, robustness has been shown to depend on distributional stability and tail behavior rather than on average performance alone. Additionally, AMST provides a scalable and model-agnostic stress-testing methodology that enables robustness-aware evaluation and monitoring of LLM-enabled software systems operating in adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了对抗性道德压力测试（AMST）框架，用于评估LLM在多轮对抗交互中的伦理鲁棒性，通过结构化压力转换和分布感知指标来检测传统单轮评估无法发现的渐进性退化模式。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM伦理安全评估主要依赖单轮评估和聚合指标（如毒性分数和拒绝率），这些方法无法有效检测现实多轮交互中可能出现的行为不稳定、罕见但高影响的伦理失败以及渐进性退化效应。
AI.method: 提出AMST框架：1）对提示进行结构化压力转换；2）使用分布感知鲁棒性指标评估模型行为，包括方差、尾部风险和跨交互轮次的时间行为漂移；3）在受控压力条件下生成大量对抗场景进行测试。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3-8B、GPT-4o和DeepSeek-v3等先进LLM上的评估显示：不同模型的鲁棒性特征存在显著差异；暴露了传统单轮评估协议无法观察到的退化模式；鲁棒性取决于分布稳定性和尾部行为而非仅平均性能。
AI.conclusion: AMST提供了一个可扩展且模型无关的压力测试方法，能够在对抗环境中对LLM赋能的软件系统进行鲁棒性感知的评估和监控，有助于发现传统评估方法无法检测的伦理风险。

title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level. Our probes achieve 1.00 AUROC in-distribution and 0.60--0.86 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and a steganographic blackjack card-counting task. We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, suggesting that different forms of collusion manifest differently in activation space. We also find preliminary evidence that this signal is localised at the token level, with the colluding agent's activations spiking specifically when processing the encoded parts of their partner's message. This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion, particularly for organisations with access to model activations. Code and data are available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了NARCBench基准，用于评估多智能体环境分布变化下的共谋检测，并开发了五种基于模型内部激活的探测技术来检测多智能体系统中的隐蔽协调行为。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在多智能体系统中的广泛应用，它们引入了隐蔽协调的风险，这可能逃避标准的人类监督形式。虽然线性探测在单智能体环境中已显示出检测欺骗的潜力，但共谋本质上是一种多智能体现象，使用内部表示来检测智能体之间的共谋仍然未被探索。
AI.method: 研究者引入了NARCBench基准来评估环境分布变化下的共谋检测，并提出了五种探测技术，通过聚合每个智能体的欺骗分数来在群体层面分类场景。这些技术基于模型内部激活进行分析，特别关注令牌级别的信号定位。
AI.result: 探测技术在分布内实现了1.00 AUROC，在零样本迁移到结构不同的多智能体场景和隐写术二十一点算牌任务时实现了0.60-0.86 AUROC。研究发现没有单一的探测技术在所有共谋类型中占主导地位，这表明不同形式的共谋在激活空间中的表现不同。初步证据还显示信号在令牌级别定位，共谋智能体的激活在处理其伙伴消息的编码部分时特别增强。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作向多智能体可解释性迈出了一步：将白盒检查从单一模型扩展到多智能体环境，其中检测需要跨智能体聚合信号。结果表明，模型内部为检测多智能体共谋提供了与文本级监控互补的信号，特别是对于能够访问模型激活的组织。

title: Therefore I am. I Think
summary: We consider the question: when a large language reasoning model makes a choice, did it think first and then decide to, or decide first and then think? In this paper, we present evidence that detectable, early-encoded decisions shape chain-of-thought in reasoning models. Specifically, we show that a simple linear probe successfully decodes tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations with very high confidence, and in some cases, even before a single reasoning token is produced. Activation steering supports this causally: perturbing the decision direction leads to inflated deliberation, and flips behavior in many examples (between 7 - 79% depending on model and benchmark). We also show through behavioral analysis that, when steering changes the decision, the chain-of-thought process often rationalizes the flip rather than resisting it. Together, these results suggest that reasoning models can encode action choices before they begin to deliberate in text.

title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers
summary: We present HippoCamp, a new benchmark designed to evaluate agents' capabilities on multimodal file management. Unlike existing agent benchmarks that focus on tasks like web interaction, tool use, or software automation in generic settings, HippoCamp evaluates agents in user-centric environments to model individual user profiles and search massive personal files for context-aware reasoning. Our benchmark instantiates device-scale file systems over real-world profiles spanning diverse modalities, comprising 42.4 GB of data across over 2K real-world files. Building upon the raw files, we construct 581 QA pairs to assess agents' capabilities in search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning. To facilitate fine-grained analysis, we provide 46.1K densely annotated structured trajectories for step-wise failure diagnosis. We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and agentic methods on HippoCamp. Our comprehensive experiments reveal a significant performance gap: even the most advanced commercial models achieve only 48.3% accuracy in user profiling, struggling particularly with long-horizon retrieval and cross-modal reasoning within dense personal file systems. Furthermore, our step-wise failure diagnosis identifies multimodal perception and evidence grounding as the primary bottlenecks. Ultimately, HippoCamp exposes the critical limitations of current agents in realistic, user-centric environments and provides a robust foundation for developing next-generation personal AI assistants.

AI.conclusion: HippoCamp揭示了当前智能体在现实用户中心环境中的关键局限性，多模态感知和证据基础是主要瓶颈，为开发下一代个人AI助手提供了坚实基础。
